content.short: A governance-free lending and borrowing protocol on Injective and Sei, offering interest-free loans via AUSD.
content.description:
Aeroscraper is a user-centric, governance-free lending and borrowing protocol built on the Injective and Sei networks. It offers interest-free loans where borrowers pay a one-time origination fee instead of variable interest rates. Users can mint AUSD, an over-collateralized stablecoin pegged to the USD, by depositing assets like SEI or INJ as collateral.

The protocol features a Stability Pool where users deposit AUSD to earn rewards while providing a cushion against system shocks. Fully automated and immutable, Aeroscraper operates without admin keys, ensuring a decentralized and censorship-resistant financial experience.
